claims.quote: Mutation of the GABRA1 gene is associated with neurodevelopmental defects and epilepsy.

claims.object_text: encodes for the α1 subunit of the GABAAR which regulates fast inhibitory impulses
claims.quote: GABRA1 encodes for the α1 subunit of the γ-aminobutyric acid type A receptor (GABAAR), which regulates the fast inhibitory impulses of the nervous system.
nonsense mutation of the zebrafish gabra1 (sa43718 allele) gene.
The sa43718 allele causes a decrease in gabra1 mRNA expression

claims.object_text: decreased expression of other GABAAR α subunits (gabra2, gabra3, gabra5)
claims.quote: Mutation of gabra1 was accompanied by decreased mRNA expression of gabra2, gabra3, and gabra5

claims.object_text: residual GABAAR exists in the sa43718 allele
claims.quote: indicating that a residual GABAAR exists in the sa43718 allele.

claims.object_text: abnormal expression of proteins that regulate synaptic vesicle fusion, vesicle transport, synapse development, and mitochondrial protein complexes
claims.quote: Proteomics analysis demonstrated that mutation of gabra1 is associated with abnormal expression of proteins that regulate synaptic vesicle fusion, vesicle transport, synapse development, and mitochondrial protein complexes.
validate that loss of function mutations in the gabra1 gene result in seizure-like phenotypes with abnormal development of the GABA synapse.

claims.object_text: seizure-like phenotypes with abnormal development of the GABA synapse
claims.quote: result in seizure-like phenotypes with abnormal development of the GABA synapse.
